laraib.name: Laraib
laraib.title: To My Dearest Friend on Your 24th Birthday
content: You have been w me in the midst of chaos, when i couldn't find myself to speak you sat quietly, shouted when you felt like i wasn't doing enough, talked to me when i needed the most.

You have been through hell yourself but never fail to make me feel better even on the days when you feel down. Its sad that this might be your last birthday in pakistan and im not there nor i can do anything to make it special for you but i promise one day i will.

I will meet you like i promised you. I will be there like i have always been. Im so glad Allah chose you to be in my life otherwise i would'nt have ever understood what its like to have a friend in this world.
I pray that i meet u in another world as well. You as my sister in that universe too because i cant think of another sister if its not you. Tho sometimes we cant bear the sight of each other.

I have made mistakes which i will be sorry for, for the rest of my life but i wont ever leave you until the end of the world. I genuinely dont have any words to describe this bond but im glad i have you as my sister, because until my last breath i know there is someone by my side no matter what.
I have said it before ill say it again. You have the purest heart on this planet. Its sad because you wont be there when i go back to pakistan now. Kills me. But thats how life is.

I hope we can meet as much as we discuss. I hope life doesn't let us fall apart from each other because that would kill me. I hope the love you have for animals and the shelter you want them to be in becomes reality. I hope life treats you kindly when im not around so you get bored and call me all the time.

Some friendships feel like they were written long before we were even born, and yours is exactly that. So here's to you, to your day, your journey, your strength, and the impact you don't even realize you've had on my life.
Distance or no distance, I'm rooting for you in ways even you don't fully understand. Happiest birthday dobby❤

aqsa.name: Aqsa
aqsa.title: Dear Anusha, Happy Birthday.
content: Happyyy Birthdayyy my dear Anusha.
Here is the heartfelt note and my thoughts which i never got a chance to express in all these years... may be cuz all we did was fun and jokes all the time.

I love you as a human and how genuine you are. From havinga soft corner for animals to humans it all shows. You have been kind to everyone and never have i ever seen, not even once that you did anyone wrong... it truly shows how amazing of a person you are. I love how you have kept a great balance, one moment throwing fits, serving looks and enjoy8ng life and other moments praying to God.

You energy is soothing if i can explain this... every time we hang out, i never felt anxious, never felt that someone will judge. It was all calm, pleasant and enjoyable. Another thing i like about you is, even in the chaos, having all the opportunities for fun, you still choose your reserved introverted self. I love your fits and insta picture ( i have stalked you a few times btw)

You were a great company at university. I truly enjoyed being with you. That one call (if you remember) when you expressed what you think about me... still lingers in my mind. In first year of university, i had plans to make a lot of friends but when we met, i never really wished for more friends. So many of our memories that miss each time i open my gallery, those khi trips, kheenjhar trip, each day that we stayed in university till 3, went to mehran by walk, explored diff departments. Before we were friends, i saw you with some other group and wished to be friends as you guys seemed fun and some how we became friends and till this days it just continued to better.

You have been blessed and you truly deserve this and even more blessings in your life. I wish and pray that God fulfills all of your desires and you have a wonderful life once you leave Pakistan. You'll be missed but Go out have fun and i'll take inspiration from your fits and pictures ...xd

Idk how many years it will take to meet again and guess that time we spent at university will never come back but still that's life. I wish you get to see how beautiful life can be in every way and you get to experience all the beauty of this life and the here after and be blessed with all the dreams and desires you have. I am not that expressive when it comes to emotions but i have tired to write at least some of what i think about you. Your image in my mind is even better than i am able to express here but now you just have to feel it energetically...xD
Happyyyy Birthdayyyy Cutieee. ILY ❤

ishaal.name: Ishaal
ishaal.title: Dear Bhabi, Happy Birthday.
content: Dear Bhabhi,
I wish you the happiest 23rd birthday💕💕 I hope you are going to enjoy your birthday with the surprise of ada, unfortunately I couldn't come, but your next birthday we will be together inshallah!

I hope you will always be happy and have many fun joyful moments in your life. I am so happy to call you my bhabhi and I couldn't think of any better one. I am excited for you to come to Germany and really hope that we will have a lot of fun here. I want to go to many places with you and just enjoy girlhood hehe.

I hope that you achieve much success, all of your dreams and that you will always stay healthy. I can't wait to see you again, rocking that red shadi dress and enjoy the rukhsati of you and ada Inshallah. I am so happy for you and wish you all the best for your future.
Thank you for everything my big sister, my bhabhi, my friend, my heart. I love you girlllll and miss you sooo much!!!!
The cooler nand,
Ishu 🫶🏼
